title: Valkyrae led clinic fundraiser; $137,000 backs low-income healthcare
summary_full: In 2025, Valkyrae was celebrated by Saban Community Clinic at its Creators in Action event, attended by over 200 influential creators and leaders. This gala successfully garnered more than $137,000, aimed at supporting low-income patients in need of medical, dental, and behavioral healthcare services. As a co-owner of 100 Thieves, Valkyrae’s influence on the gaming community is profound. The event also recognized Chris M.
